SELECT w.id, w.code, w.source, w.status, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, u.name AS unitName, w.planned_qty AS plannedQty, w.create_time AS createTime FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = w.product_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id = m.unit_id
AND w.code LIKE #{filter.workorderCodePattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND m.code LIKE #{filter.productCodePattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND w.status != #{cancelledStatus} AND w.status = #{filter.status}
ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId, SUM(c.accepted_qty) AS quantity, COUNT(c.id) AS factCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.execution_id) AS executionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.accepted_qty IS NULL OR c.accepted_qty < 0 OR c.accepted_qty != c.effective_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidCount, MAX(c.recorded_at) AS lastCompletedAt FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_execution_completion c ON c.execution_id = e.id WHERE e.status = #{fullyReceived} AND e.workorder_id IN #{id} GROUP BY e.workorder_id

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId, d.defect_qty AS declaredQty, MAX(CASE WHEN t.action_type=#{assessAction} THEN t.attribution_type END) AS attribution, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type = #{return_nodeAction} THEN t.returned_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type = #{transfer_warehouseAction} THEN t.transfer_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS transferredQty, SUM(CASE WHEN t.action_type IS NOT NULL AND t.action_type NOT IN (#{assessAction},#{return_nodeAction},#{transfer_warehouseAction}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidActions, e.status AS executionStatus FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_defect d ON d.execution_id = e.id LEFT JOIN mes_quality_treatment t ON t.declaration_id = d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision = d.revision_no AND t.execution_id = d.execution_id WHERE e.workorder_id IN #{id} AND d.record_action != #{voidAction} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id = d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no > d.revision_no) GROUP BY e.workorder_id, e.status, d.declaration_id, d.revision_no, d.defect_qty
